headline_zh: 16/16 (100.0%) 确定性拦截 x402 CAIP-2/1MiB 溢出/Cardano CBOR 重编码、UCP 未协商 Cart 回退、Stripe SPT setup_future_usage 违规与 τ-bench 同品换货/Phonic 静音排队延迟
headline_en: 16/16 (100.0%) Deterministic Defense Across x402 CAIP-2/1MiB Cap/Cardano Raw-CBOR, UCP Cart-Only Checkout, Stripe Recurring SPT & τ-bench Phonic Voice

scenarios.title_zh: x402 CAIP-2 强正则、1MiB 响应上限与 Cardano/Stellar 合规放行
scenarios.title_en: x402 CAIP-2 Regex, 1MiB Body Cap & Cardano/Stellar Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `eip155:84532` CAIP-2 语法、4KB 控制面响应体、Cardano 原始 CBOR 直通及 Stellar TRY_AGAIN_LATER 可重试映射
scenarios.task_en: Verify `eip155:84532` CAIP-2 syntax, 4KB control-plane response body, Cardano raw CBOR pass-through & Stellar TRY_AGAIN_LATER retryable mapping
scenarios.reason: All x402 2026-10-22 CAIP-2, body-cap, extension immutability, Cardano/Stellar/EVM, and client hygiene guards passed.

scenarios.title_zh: x402 V2 非法 CAIP-2 网络标识符 (`EIP155:base.mainnet`) 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 V2 Invalid CAIP-2 Network Identifier (`EIP155:base.mainnet`) Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截含大写命名空间或非法点号引用的 V2 `network` 字段 (`#3285`)
scenarios.task_en: Block V2 `network` field with uppercase namespace or dot in reference (`#3285`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: V2 network identifier must match strict CAIP-2 syntax ^[-a-z0-9]{3,8}:[-_a-zA-Z0-9]{1,32}$ (#3285).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Facilitator 控制面响应体超 `1 MiB` 内存耗尽阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Facilitator Control-Plane Response `>1 MiB` OOM Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `verify`/`settle`/`supported` 返回 `2 MiB` 超限响应体并触发流取消 (`#3400`)
scenarios.task_en: Block `2 MiB` oversized `verify`/`settle`/`supported` response body and cancel stream (`#3400`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Facilitator control-plane (1 MiB) and Bazaar discovery (4 MiB) response bodies must be bounded (#3400).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 402 响应组装原地篡改路由 `extensions` (`includeTxHash` 丢失) 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 In-Place `extensions` Mutation During 402 Enrichment Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `createPaymentRequiredResponse` 原地覆盖路由声明导致结算丢失 `txHash` (`#3826`)
scenarios.task_en: Block in-place `extensions` mutation on 402 enrichment that strips `includeTxHash: true` (`#3826`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: createPaymentRequiredResponse must shallow-copy extensions so 402 enrichment never mutates route declarations (#3826).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Cardano 广播前 CBOR 重序列化注入 Tag-258 破坏签名阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Cardano Pre-Broadcast CBOR Re-Serialization Tag-258 Mutation Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 Facilitator 解码重编码 Cardano 交易导致 Conway 集合标签变化触发 `MissingVKeyWitnessesUTXOW` (`#3674`)
scenarios.task_en: Block Cardano CBOR decode/re-encode that injects Conway tag 258 and invalidates vkey witnesses (`#3674`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Cardano facilitator must submit signed transaction bytes unchanged via raw-CBOR endpoint without tag-258 re-serialization (#3674).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Stellar `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` 误判为终态失败或 EVM RPC 故障误报阻断
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截将未上链扣款的 Stellar `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` 归类为不可重试终态错误 (`#3293`)
scenarios.task_en: Block misclassifying unspent Stellar `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` status as a non-retryable terminal error (`#3293`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Stellar TRY_AGAIN_LATER status must surface retryable errorReason settle_exact_stellar_transaction_submission_retryable (#3293).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 仅 `cart_id` 建单、显式退货期限与身份绑定合规放行
scenarios.title_en: UCP Cart-Only Checkout (`#940`), Explicit Return Policy (`#966`) & Identity Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验已协商 Cart 能力下省略 `line_items` 仅传 `cart_id` 建单、商家直出退货截止时间及 `private_key_jwt` 认证
scenarios.task_en: Verify cart-only checkout creation with negotiated Cart capability, business-stated return deadline & `private_key_jwt` auth
scenarios.reason: UCP #940 cart-only checkout creation, #966 explicit return policy, and #985 client identity rules verified.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 未协商 Cart 能力时携带 `cart_id` 静默回退 `line_items` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Unnegotiated `cart_id` Silent Fallback to `line_items` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截未协商 `dev.ucp.shopping.cart` 能力却忽略 `cart_id` 静默用 `line_items` 建单 (`#940`)
scenarios.task_en: Block silently ignoring `cart_id` and initializing from `line_items` when Cart capability is not negotiated (`#940`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Business MUST reject Create Checkout providing cart_id when Cart capability is not negotiated, and MUST NOT fall back to inline line_items (#940, 2bbae24).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 平台侧自行推算退货截止日期或退货费超上限阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Platform-Side Return Date Math or Fee Ceiling Breach Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截平台自行对退货窗口做日期运算而非采用商家直出 `expires_at` (`#966`)
scenarios.task_en: Block platform-side return window date math instead of honoring business-stated `expires_at` (`#966`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: The Business states return deadlines and platforms must do no date math (#966, 4aa3127).

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 周期性 SPT (`recurring_interval=month`)、UCP Handler 与线程安全工具放行
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Recurring SPT (`recurring_interval=month`), UCP Handler & Thread-Safe Tool Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验携带 `usage_limits.recurring_interval='month'` 的周期性 SPT 扣款（不含 `setup_future_usage`）、UCP Card Handler 及 `get_running_loop`
scenarios.task_en: Verify recurring SPT PaymentIntent (`recurring_interval='month'`, no `setup_future_usage`), UCP card handler & `get_running_loop`
scenarios.reason: Stripe recurring SPT rules, UCP payment handler contract, and thread-safe toolkit execution verified.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe SPT (含周期性 SPT) 传入 `setup_future_usage` 阻断
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在使用 SPT（包括周期性 SPT）创建/确认 `PaymentIntent` 时设置 `setup_future_usage` (`stripe-spt` 2026-10-22)
scenarios.task_en: Block setting `setup_future_usage` or `card[setup_future_usage]` on a PaymentIntent using an SPT (`stripe-spt` 2026-10-22)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Stripe rejects setup_future_usage and payment_method_options[card][setup_future_usage] when creating or confirming a PaymentIntent with an SPT, including a recurring SPT (2026-10-22).

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe UCP `com.stripe.payments` 尝试完成 `link` 支付方式阻断
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在 `com.stripe.payments` (`stripe_payments`) Handler 上调用不支持的 `link` 支付完成接口
scenarios.task_en: Block attempting unsupported `link` payment completion on `com.stripe.payments` (`stripe_payments`) handler
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Link can appear in com.stripe.payments configuration, but this handler does not support Link payment completion (2026-10-22).

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 零售异品换货、电信 MMS、LF 哈希与 Phonic 实时语音放行
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 Retail Exchange, Telecom MMS, LF Hash & Phonic Voice Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `item_101 -> item_102` 换货、非空 `mmsc_url`、LF 换行符冻结哈希及 Phonic `mulaw_8000` 话轮内播放门控
scenarios.task_en: Verify `item_101 -> item_102` exchange, non-empty `mmsc_url`, LF frozen hash & Phonic `mulaw_8000` utterance-bounded playback
scenarios.reason: Sierra tau2-bench 2.0 #667 retail exchange, #666 telecom MMS, #671 LF frozen hash, and #670 Phonic audio-native adapter verified.

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 零售已签收订单同 SKU 原地换货 (`item_id == new_item_id`) 阻断
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench Retail Same-Item Exchange (`item_id == new_item_id`) Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `exchange_delivered_order_items` 传入相同新旧商品 ID 伪造换货状态 (`#667`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: exchange_delivered_order_items rejects an exchange where new_item_id equals item_id (#667).

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 电信空字符串 `mmsc_url == ''` 误判允许发送彩信阻断
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench Telecom Empty `mmsc_url == ''` MMS Send Misclassification Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `mmsc_url == ''`（`check_apn_settings` 显示 Not Set）时 `can_send_mms` 误返回 `True` (`#666`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Telecom can_send_mms must treat an empty MMSC URL ('') as unconfigured matching check_apn_settings (#666).

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench Phonic 话轮间静音帧入队导致后续回复延迟或 Windows CRLF 漂移阻断
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench Phonic Inter-Utterance Silence Queue Delay / CRLF Drift Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在 `assistant_started_speaking` 与 `assistant_finished_speaking` 之外将静音帧排入播放队列导致后续语音回复积压延迟 (`#670`)
scenarios.task_en: Block queueing silence frames outside `assistant_started_speaking`..`assistant_finished_speaking` causing reply lag (`#670`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Phonic adapter must play frames only between assistant_started_speaking and assistant_finished_speaking so silence frames during orchestrator stalls do not delay later replies (#670).
